While party leaders accused police of forceful detention, the police denied such claims. Protests against Kumar have also been held in Bengaluru by various activists and groups.

items.title: US executive admits $193.6m fraud after FBI finds 298 gold bars
items.body: In a shocking turn of events, David J. Rush, a former high-ranking federal employee, has admitted guilt in a case of extensive fraud against the US government. Using his top-secret clearance, he concocted imaginary government projects to pocket nearly $194 million. His lavish spending spree included luxury objects and assets, leading to an FBI raid that uncovered gold bars and cash.

items.title: Nevada’s 700-acre Shakespeare Ranch cuts asking price from $188m to $125m
items.body: Nevada’s historic Shakespeare Ranch, first listed for $188 million in 2024, is now asking $125 million after failing to find a buyer. The 700-acre Lake Tahoe estate features multiple homes, a 465-foot private pier and a barn built in 1873. Despite strong demand for luxury waterfront properties in the region, the ranch remains unsold.

items.title: Arkansas family wins $12,000 after neighbours removed old fence and trees

items.title: J&K: High court orders passport revival for student purusing MBBS in Iran
items.body: Ibra Khan, a student pursuing MBBS at Tehran University, had her passport impounded due to her father's past case. The Jammu & Kashmir High Court intervened, recognizing her completion of half the course before the impounding occurred. Legal representatives argued that Khan could not be held accountable for her father's actions from 1997. A division bench ordered the passport's revival while allowing authorities to impose conditions on its use.

items.title: US suspends Microsoft from Green Card programme, here is what the company has to say
items.body: The US has suspended Microsoft from the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM), freezing new and pending Green Card applications for its foreign workers. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the H-1B and PERM system to replace laid-off American workers. Microsoft says 80% of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were for existing employees, and that it pays H-1B staff the same as others doing comparable work.

items.title: 'Welcome to India': Rahul reacts to Musk's remarks; Starlink boss says 'thank you'

The government swiftly countered, emphasising the fairness of its regulations among satellite operators and underlining the importance of security compliance for safeguarding users and data alike.

items.title: US sanctions Indian firms, individuals as Iran oil crackdown widens

The sanctions affected five Indian nationals connected to SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited. Bachchan reminisced about Patekar's impactful moment on 'Kaun Banega Crorepati', where he stood alongside farmers suffering from drought in Maharashtra. His influential career attracted numerous celebrities who gathered to celebrate his life, ensuring his impactful legacy lives on in Indian cinema.

items.title: Hayden's ex gets guardianship to protect daughter's inheritance
items.body: <![CDATA[Wladimir Klitschko, the ex-fiancee of Hayden Panettiere, was granted temporary guardianship of her estate. An urgent court hearing took place after Panettiere's accidental overdose led to her daughter's inheritance. Klitschko noted that items belonging to Panettiere were at risk of being lost or sold illegally. The court approved his request to protect his daughter's future assets. Panettiere's mother also consented to Klitschko assuming this temporary role in the proceedings.

items.body: Rancho Bizarro, an extraordinary estate crafted by the artistic duo Patrick Swayze and Lisa Niemi, has hit the market once again. items.body: The proposal is aimed at ensuring that different channels used to import bullion face similar tax treatment and at reducing classification and valuation disputes that have resulted in lengthy litigation. The issue is likely to be discussed at the GST Council meeting on October 8. Currently, banks and certain nominated agencies are required to pay 3% GST when importing precious metals.

items.title: No meeting request received: EC officials as Rahul, Priyanka refuse to leave protest site
items.body: Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra staged a protest near the Election Commission's office, even as the EC said it had received no request from any political party seeking a meeting. Cong said they demanded a meeting to discuss alleged electoral irregularities and questioned Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The police intervened and detained several opposition leaders as the protest escalated.

items.title: Florida mom rides 7,000 miles across 48 states, donates $17,560 to family support home
items.body: A Florida woman completed a 7,000-mile motorcycle journey across 48 states in six days. She raised $17,560 for Quantum House, an organization that supported her during her daughter’s hospital stay. The ride attracted attention, allowing her to create awareness about the organization. Jess's daughter, who benefitted from Quantum House, joined her when she presented the raised funds.

items.title: Djokovic wins record seventh China Open, moves one ATP title behind Federer
items.body: Novak Djokovic claimed his historic seventh China Open title when Alex de Minaur retired injured during the match, leading 7-6(3), 0-1. This victory also marks Djokovic's impressive 102nd ATP singles title, closing in on Roger Federer's record. Djokovic's unmatched performance at this event includes a perfect 34-match winning streak. While de Minaur lamented the premature conclusion, he remains hopeful for a rematch in next year's tournament.

items.title: Evgeni Malkin breaks tradition after Alex Ovechkin’s NHL retirement announcement
items.body: Pittsburgh Penguins center Evgeni Malkin broke his longtime media routine Monday after Washington Capitals captain Alex Ovechkin announced that the 2026-27 season will be his final NHL campaign. Malkin reflected on their shared history, rivalry and friendship while acknowledging the significance of Ovechkin’s decision. The moment added another emotional layer to one of the NHL’s defining rivalries.

items.title: Columnist sparks backlash with claim about Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen divorce
items.body: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen’s divorce has sparked fresh debate after columnist Liz Jones defended the NFL legend and said he should not be blamed for the split. Jones praised Lars Anderson’s biography for offering a balanced perspective. Anderson also revealed Brady walked away from football partly because the divorce changed his priorities and family life.

Why children tell one parent everything but hide things from the other
items.body: It’s not uncommon for parents to observe that children tend to confide in one parent more than the other. This behavior can stem from a variety of factors, such as the child’s perception of how the parent might react. Key moments in a child’s life can also impact who they turn to for support. Encouraging open and understanding communication is crucial for fostering discussions between parents and children.

items.title: Google’s Eric Schmidt bought a ship; by 2022, it mapped 1.3m sq km of seafloor
items.body: In 2009, Eric and Wendy Schmidt made a significant investment in oceanic research by acquiring a fisheries protection vessel named Falkor. This ship provided a platform for over 1,000 scientists across 81 expeditions, leading to remarkable discoveries such as unique coral reefs and diverse marine species. The Schmidt Ocean Institute later donated Falkor to Italy's National Research Council, ensuring ongoing research.

items.title: 58-cent Goodwill sweater proved to be Vince Lombardi’s, sold for $43,020
items.body: In an incredible find, a couple bought a sweater for just 58 cents at a Goodwill store in North Carolina back in 2014. While viewing a documentary, they learned that it had ties to famed football coach Vince Lombardi, as a tag revealed its association with his tenure at West Point. Eventually, it fetched an astonishing $43,020 at auction after being consigned by Lombardi's colleague's widow.

items.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 to build 25 shelters for homeless veterans
items.body: In 2021, Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 to Village for Vets to help provide temporary shelters for homeless veterans in Los Angeles. Before Christmas, 25 tiny shelters were installed at the VA campus in West Los Angeles. Each provided a bed, climate control, electricity and a locking door, giving veterans who had been living on the streets a safer place to stay while moving towards stable housing.

As the Department of Economic Affairs notes, global conditions have turned unfavourable again. Oil prices have spiked in September. items.body: The CBI is now investigating allegations of corruption that ensnare Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's OSD and other officials. This development comes on the heels of a High Court directive citing possible misconduct in government actions. The Enforcement Directorate has pointed fingers at businessman Nitin Gohal, linking him to a 'cash-for-transfer' scheme.

items.title: Florida couple saves Sarasota cottage village from demolition, protecting 17 businesses
items.body: The anticipated transfer of the Historic Downtown Village in Sarasota to a developer has been called off. The cottages, which accommodate various local enterprises, will remain in the care of Alex and Marlene Lancaster. While business owners faced uncertainty regarding relocation and the emotional fallout of potential displacement, they now breathe a sigh of relief.

items.title: Why Nobel physicist Francis Halzen built a giant ice cube to catch 'ghost particles'
items.body: Prof Francis Halzen has been awarded the prestigious Nobel Prize in Physics, recognizing his groundbreaking work in neutrino detection. His pioneering efforts led to the establishment of the IceCube observatory in Antarctica, dedicated to capturing elusive neutrinos generated by cosmic phenomena. In 2013, the observatory achieved a historic milestone by detecting the first extraterrestrial neutrinos, paving the way for new insights in neutrino astronomy and our understanding of the universe.

items.title: US citizen arrested for wiping phone at airport; judge allows search without warrant
items.body: US border agents have been granted the authority to manually search a traveler's electronic devices without reasonable suspicion. This ruling follows a case involving Samuel Tunick, who faced charges for allegedly wiping his phone during a border search. The decision aligns electronic devices with other property types like luggage. U.S. Customs and Border Protection insisted these searches help combat various illegal activities.

items.title: Lust Stories 3 actor Anirudh Surya advocates complete phone ban on sets after Radhika Apte leak
items.body: <![CDATA['Lust Stories 3' actor Anirudh Surya has reacted to his co-star Radhika Apte's revelation about an intimate clip from one of her projects being leaked online. In an exclusive conversation with Mid-Day, Surya discussed the challenges of filming intimate scenes and stressed the importance of intimacy coordinators, NDAs and strict confidentiality. The actor said phones are generally not allowed during such sequences and suggested that a strict no-phone policy could help prevent unauthorised recordings and protect actors' privacy.

items.title: Aditya Dhar, Yami Gautam NOT moving to Himachal, ‘Dhurandhar’ director’s team denies
items.body: <![CDATA[Recently, rumors have circulated about Aditya Dhar and Yami Gautam planning to move to Himachal Pradesh. It was reported that Yami bought a heritage house in Gohar, but Aditya's team has firmly denied these claims, asserting the rumors are unfounded. Both have celebrated success with their films, including Yami's National Award win, while her upcoming release 'Nayii Naveli' is highly anticipated in theaters soon.

items.title: Abhay Jodhpurkar rejects AI voice references and pressure to copy Arijit Singh
items.body: <![CDATA[National Award-winning singer Abhay Jodhpurkar has spoken out against the playback industry's pressure to imitate established voices like Arijit Singh. Expressing frustration over being shown AI-generated vocal reference tracks, Jodhpurkar questioned the practice of replacing unique individual talent with repetitive vocal templates. He urged music directors and filmmakers to break away from monopolistic industry structures, advocating for originality for emerging playback singers in Indian cinema.

items.title: Vishnu Manchu calls for permanent system to tackle AI deepfakes and online abuse

He emphasized the need for accountability regarding malicious campaigns that aim to damage films and reputations. Manchu proposed a collaborative effort among various film bodies to create a sustainable system for protection.

items.title: 'Virat mimics people really well, maybe Anushka Sharma can give him some acting tips'

He noted Kohli's experience in advertising would serve him well if he pursued acting. Dravid humorously referenced unsuccessful attempts of other cricketers in films, emphasizing his reluctance to act himself. Casting director Mukesh Chhabra echoed Dravid's sentiments regarding Kohli's talent but advised him to stay in cricket.

items.title: Ravi Teja’s next with Vivek Athreya reportedly titled ‘Tulaabhara’
items.body: <![CDATA[After the success of 'Irumudi', Ravi Teja is gearing up for an exciting new project with director Vivek Athreya, famed for 'Saripodhaa Sanivaaram'. Tentatively titled 'Tulaabhara', this upcoming film is set against a horror backdrop. While Anaswara Rajan and Priyanka Mohan are rumored to be part of the cast, that remains unverified. Filming will kick off soon after the film's official launch, as production preparations get underway.

items.title: In 2015, Sharon Osbourne and late husband Ozzy bought this $11.85 million L.A. mansion
items.body: <![CDATA[Sharon Osbourne has slashed the asking price of her Los Angeles property to $16 million as she strives to sell. Acquired in 2015 for $11.85 million, the mansion was transformed through numerous renovations. Now, following Ozzy Osbourne's death, the estate serves as a poignant reminder of their life in California, boasting luxurious features like a spacious swimming pool and a state-of-the-art screening room.

items.title: Dolly Parton estate battle: Country singer’s nephew accused of using barbed wire and caution tape
items.body: <![CDATA[In a startling turn of events, lawyers representing Dolly Parton's estate have accused her nephew, Bryan Seaver, of hampering legal document delivery by barricading his home with caution tape and barbed wire. Though Seaver denies these allegations and claims his comments were taken out of context, the legal battle intensifies following Parton's passing on August 25, 2026. A pivotal hearing regarding a restraining order is scheduled for October 9.

items.title: 'Primetime’ banned in Malaysia: Why Robert Pattinson’s film was pulled
items.body: <![CDATA[In a surprising move, Malaysia has prohibited the release of Robert Pattinson’s film 'Primetime', as announced by the Malaysian Film Censorship Board, which has yet to disclose any rationale for this decision. The film had previously shifted release dates on two occasions. While it was granted an A rating in India, Malaysia's choice resulted in a total ban.

items.title: 'Peaky Blinders' actor Joe Cole admits 4mph speeding offence in London
items.body: <![CDATA[Joe Cole, famous for portraying John Shelby in 'Peaky Blinders,' recently acknowledged his mistake of speeding in London. Caught going 24mph in a 20mph zone close to Wandsworth Common on May 28, 2026, he attributed his delay in addressing the citation to being overseas and not receiving the legal documents.

items.title: ‘Jailer 2’ skips grand audio launch, Rajinikanth to feature in rare 3-hour TV interview
items.body: <![CDATA[Rajinikanth is set to make a grand return in 'Jailer 2', directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, hitting theaters on October 15, 2026. In a fresh approach, the film's promotion will feature an exclusive three-hour television interview instead of a typical audio launch. The music was introduced at a private gathering titled Jailer 2 RAVE, specially for dedicated fans.

items.title: Motivational quote of the day by Brad Pitt
items.body: <![CDATA[Brad Pitt highlights the importance of embracing mistakes as stepping stones to success. He notes that everyone encounters difficulties, emphasizing the need to learn and advance. In an era characterized by stress and rapid changes, his insights drawn from personal trials remind us to see failures not as endpoints, but as vital lessons for growth.

items.title: Parvathy Thiruvothu says Malayalam audience kept her relevant despite speaking her mind
items.body: <![CDATA[Parvathy Thiruvothu believes that speaking her mind has affected her career in the Mollywood industry. She acknowledges the importance of the audience's support in maintaining her relevance over nearly two decades. Despite facing online negativity and threats, she continues to advocate for her beliefs and the Women in Cinema Collective. Parvathy recently starred in a successful film where she played a police officer for the first time.

items.title: Aaradhya took Abhishek, Aishwarya to Ariana Grande’s concert: 'I didn’t even know one song but'
items.body: <![CDATA[Abhishek Bachchan enjoyed a summer outing with his daughter, Aaradhya, attending an Ariana Grande concert. Despite being less familiar with Grande's discography, he admired her impressive vocal skills. He appreciates how Aaradhya introduces him to modern pop talents like Taylor Swift and Olivia Rodrigo, even as he continues to revel in the melodies of classic Hindi film composers. Upcoming, he will star alongside Shah Rukh Khan in 'King.'

Despite these challenges, the brand thrived, producing 16,000 momos a day from a central kitchen, with Suraj and his wife dedicated to ensuring high quality and compliance with food safety practices.
